$comment: Fireup brand tokens — single source of truth. tokens/brand.css is generated from this file by `npm run tokens`. Do not edit the CSS by hand.
name: Fireup
status: mark approved (round 5A); lockup is round 8 — the mark as the word's F, with the arc over the Up — and sign-off on it is still open (SAK-173)

colorNotes.ember: Primary accent. Use on ink only — on white it is 3.11:1, which carries a logo or a 24px+ heading but never body text.
colorNotes.ember-deep: The light-background counterpart of ember: accent text, links, and the primary button fill with white text.
colorNotes.rule-dark: Decorative hairline on dark. Carries no meaning on its own, so it is exempt from the 3:1 non-text minimum; use border-dark where an edge has to be perceivable.
colorNotes.rule-light: Decorative hairline on light, same exemption as rule-dark.
colorNotes.status: ok/warn pairs always ship with a text label or glyph — colour never carries the meaning alone.

font.sans: 'Inter var', Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

fontNotes: The site ships no font files. It asks for Inter and falls back to the platform UI stack, so there is no webfont licence to clear and no third-party request at load time.
sizeNotes: A 1.2 (minor third) modular scale on a 16px base. Display sizes clamp between step-4 and step-6 in CSS.

logo.clearSpace: On all sides, equal to the height of one bar of the mark (1/8 of the mark's height). Nothing else sits inside it.
logo.minSizeLockup: 96px wide — below that, use the mark alone.
